visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up, panning shot of a highly detailed, weathered yellow mecha model titled 'The-O'. The robot is bulky with a matte finish, standing on a grey industrial-themed base with numerical markings and a metal grate texture. The background shows a crowded exhibition hall with various other model displays and blurry figures of attendees walking by under bright, even indoor lighting. (2) The camera transitions to a red, white, and black mecha model named 'GP-Impulse', posed dynamically as if in mid-flight atop a polished wooden circular stand. The model features sharp angles, multiple thrusters, and a long rifle accessory, showcasing a clean, high-contrast paint job compared to the previous weathered unit. (3) Next, a pink, rounded mecha labeled 'SAKURA' is displayed on a scenic base featuring artificial grass and small flowers. It holds two glowing green energy swords in an outstretched pose. The camera slowly pans around the model, highlighting its metallic pink sheen and the delicate floral details on the base. (4) The scene shifts to a slender, multi-colored mecha with a futuristic aesthetic, holding a shield and a jagged sword. It is mounted on a tall black pedestal against a backdrop of a colorful, abstract graphic banner. The lighting highlights its iridescent paint and complex joint structures. (5) A more elaborate diorama is showcased, featuring a dark purple mecha with organic-looking wings and a monstrous skeletal creature. The base simulates a volcanic or fiery eruption with glowing orange and red textures, creating a dramatic, high-contrast visual effect. (6) A unique blue mecha titled 'The Smiling Voyager' is shown, featuring a large transparent dome on its chest with a small human pilot figure visible inside. The robot has a utilitarian, slightly retro design with bright orange accents and sits on a simple grey platform. (7) A tall, spindly purple and blue mecha called 'Haretsu no Ningyou' is presented, featuring numerous thin blades and energy effects. Its paint has a metallic, color-shifting quality that catches the overhead studio lighting as the camera moves. (8) Two green, military-style mecha models are displayed on a heavily rusted industrial diorama base labeled '最後防線'. They are equipped with large cannons and show extensive battle damage and weathering, emphasizing a gritty, realistic aesthetic. (9) A green walker-style mecha named 'MA.K VICTOR' is shown on a dusty, cracked concrete base. The design is compact and mechanical, with visible rivets and a weathered olive drab paint scheme, posed as if traversing a wasteland. (10) The final shot features a blue and grey Gundam-style mecha standing on a jagged, grey rock formation. It holds two glowing pink beam sabers and has a red and gold flight pack on its back, posed majestically to conclude the showcase.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a steady, high-tempo electronic dance track featuring a prominent synthesizer melody and a driving 4/4 drum machine beat. In the background, a low-level murmur of crowd chatter from an indoor venue is audible, creating an atmosphere of a busy public event. (2) A male voice enters the mix, speaking in a casual, appreciative tone in Chinese about the model displays. The voice has a moderate pitch and clear articulation, occasionally rising in pitch when expressing interest. The electronic music continues at a consistent volume underneath the speech. (3) As the camera pans to different models, the background chatter shifts slightly in timbre as the microphone moves through the crowd. Another male voice is briefly heard in the distance, laughing softly. The BGM remains the primary auditory element, maintaining a high spectral brightness and rhythmic energy. (4) Towards the end of the clip, the primary speaker's voice becomes more frequent, discussing the details of the 'MA.K' and Gundam models. The interplay between the structured, upbeat music and the organic, spontaneous environmental sounds of the exhibition provides a lively acoustic backdrop for the visual showcase.
